Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.

Every call starts a fresh login shell in /testbed, so changes of directory and environment variables do not carry over between calls. A command is stopped after 300 seconds. Output longer than 10,000 characters is shortened in the middle.

command.description: The command or script to run.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Show the contents of a text file with line numbers. Use start_line and end_line (1-based, inclusive) to show part of a long file. At most 10,000 characters are returned per call.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

end_line.description: Last line to show (default: the end of the file).

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence of old_string in a file with new_string. old_string must match the current text of the file exactly, including whitespace and indentation, and must occur exactly once; include enough surrounding lines to make it unique. To delete text, use an empty new_string.

file_path.description: Path of the file to edit, absolute or relative to /testbed.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. An existing file is overwritten; a new file is created together with any missing parent directories.

file_path.description: Path of the file, absolute or relative to /testbed.

content.description: The complete new contents of the file.

function.name: submit
function.description: Finish the task. Call this once you have made and checked your changes: the current state of the files under /testbed is taken as your solution. No further tool calls are possible afterwards.
